name: antigravity-vscode-autoaccept
description: Auto accept command approvals in the latest tested official Antigravity extension for VS Code.

commands.title: Antigravity VS Code Auto Accept: Toggle ON/OFF
Antigravity VS Code Auto Accept: Show Logs
Antigravity VS Code Auto Accept: Check Connection

antigravityVscodeAutoAccept.enabled.description: Automatically allow command permission cards in this trusted workspace. Explicit Ask rules and non-command questions stay manual.

antigravitySidebarAutoAccept.enabled.deprecationMessage: Use antigravityVscodeAutoAccept.enabled. The old value is used only when the new setting is not explicitly configured.

antigravitySidebarAutoAccept.intervalMs.deprecationMessage: Use antigravityVscodeAutoAccept.intervalMs. The old value is used only when the new setting is not explicitly configured.

scripts.check: node --check core.js && node --check extension.js && node --check settings.js
scripts.package: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('dist', { recursive: true })" && vsce package --githubBranch main --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --out dist/antigravity-vscode-autoaccept.vsix
scripts.package:local: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('dist', { recursive: true })" && vsce package --githubBranch main --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --out dist/antigravity-vscode-autoaccept.vsix --no-rewrite-relative-links
